description: Singapore divorce statistics. Defaults to total divorces & annulments; use `indicator` for other series (e.g. 'Civil Divorces', 'Muslim Divorces', 'Median Duration Of Marriage For Divorces'). Annual, from DOS via SingStat (M830201).

indicator.description: Series to return (substring match). Default 'Total Divorces And Annulments'.

name: sg_divorces
